technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with overbought conditions and weak trend structure; RSI and AO show short-term bullish pressure but lack confirmation from MACD and long-term moving averages, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 59 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional (junior member, small amounts); market fear (40 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and no institutional conviction limit upside conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (338.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, FOMC event in 2 days, and earnings binary in 59 days create compounded downside risk for ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 rising, AO cross-up, and OBV rising show short-term momentum inflection with price near support (269.22) in a fear-driven market offering contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI), price below EMA-200 and Ichimoku cloud, no MACD confirmation, VIX crisis levels, FOMC in 2 days, earnings binary in 59 days, and weak fundamentals (no insider/institutional conviction) create compounded downside risk that outweighs short-term momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI 9 rising, AO cross-up) offers contrarian entry near support in fear-driven market; however, compounded macro and fundamental headwinds overwhelm tactical opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC decision in 2 days combined with earnings binary in 59 days creates binary downside risk; overbought oscillators and price below EMA-200/Ichimoku cloud signal weak trend structure despite momentum inflection.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical shows short-term bullish setup but all other agents (fundamental, sentiment, risk, debate) strongly bearish; macro environment and earnings proximity override momentum signals.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ACN position with 9 existing IT sector positions (18% sector concentration); skip entry to avoid compounding concentration risk and earnings exposure in unfavourable macro environment.
